records.jp: コーヒーかぁ。ちょっと意外だったな
records.en_original: Coffee, huh? Not what I was expecting.
records.en_auxiliary: Coffee, huh? Not what I was expecting.
records.en: Coffee, huh. I didn't expect that.

records.jp: わたしも最初は料理を作ろうと思ってたんですけど、<CR>なぜかふと、頭の中に浮かんできて……
records.en_original: I thought I would make her something to eat at first, but for some reason this came to mind...
records.en_auxiliary: I thought I would make her something to eat at first, but for some reason this came to mind...
records.en: At first, I was going to make her some food,<CR>but for some reason, coffee suddenly came to mind...

records.jp: 頭の中に、か……
records.en_original: Came to mind, huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Came to mind, huh...?
records.en: Came to mind, huh...?

records.jp: ……うん、じゃあ早速こころに飲んでみてもらおうよ！
records.en_original: ...Well then, let's have Kokoro try it!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Well then, let's have Kokoro try it!
records.en: Okay, then let's have Kokoro try it right away!

records.jp: はい！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay!
records.en: Okay!

records.jp: こころ！
records.en_original: Kokoro!
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro!
records.en: Kokoro!

records.jp: どうしたの、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: What's up, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What's up, Ao?
records.en: What's wrong, Ao-chan?

records.jp: ちょっと作業室まで来れる？
records.en_original: Could you come to the work room real quick?
records.en_auxiliary: Could you come to the work room real quick?
records.en: Can you come to the workroom for a moment?

records.jp: うん、分かった
records.en_original: Okay.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay.
records.en: Okay.

records.jp: 来たよ、愛央ちゃ――
records.en_original: Ao, I'm he—
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, I'm he—
records.en: I'm here, Ao-cha—

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃんも……？　どうしたの、二人とも……？
records.en_original: Shiho...? What are you two up to...?
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho...? What are you two up to...?
records.en: Shiho-chan too...? What are you two doing...?

records.jp: ……あのっ
ごめんなさい、わたし……<CR>あなたのことを覚えていなくて
records.en_original: I'm sorry...for not remembering you.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry...for not remembering you.
records.en: I'm sorry. I...<CR>don't remember you.

records.jp: ……こっちこそ、ごめんなさい。<CR>気持ちが整理できてなくて
records.en_original: ...No, I'm the one who should be sorry. I was avoiding you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...No, I'm the one who should be sorry. I was avoiding you.
records.en: ...No, I'm the one who should apologize.<CR>I hadn't sorted out my feelings.

records.jp: 大好きだった詩帆ちゃんが、わたしのことを<CR>覚えてないと思ったら……
records.en_original: The thought that someone I cared for so much didn't remember who I was...
records.en_auxiliary: The thought that someone I cared for so much didn't remember who I was...
records.en: When I thought Shiho-chan, whom I cared about so much,<CR>didn't remember me...

records.jp: なんだかとっても、胸が苦しくなったのです……
records.en_original: It was unbearable.
records.en_auxiliary: It was unbearable.
records.en: It made my chest hurt so much...

records.jp: わたしも、この前まで詩帆ちゃんのこと<CR>覚えてなかったのに、勝手だよね
records.en_original: But I myself just remembered you recently. It wasn't fair of me to act that way.
records.en_auxiliary: But I myself just remembered you recently. It wasn't fair of me to act that way.
records.en: I didn't remember you until just recently either,<CR>Shiho-chan. It's selfish of me, isn't it?

records.jp: 靭さん……
records.en_original: Kokoro...
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro...
records.en: Utsubo-san...

records.jp: それに、もしかしたらわたしが詩帆ちゃんを<CR>ここに呼び出しちゃったんじゃないかって思って
records.en_original: Not to mention that I might have been the one who called you here.
records.en_auxiliary: Not to mention that I might have been the one who called you here.
records.en: And I wondered if maybe I was the one<CR>who called you here, Shiho-chan.

records.jp: わたしを、呼び出した……？
records.en_original: You called me here...?
records.en_auxiliary: You called me here...?
records.en: You called me here...?

records.jp: 本当のところはわからないのです。<CR>でもあの時、わたし詩帆ちゃんに会いたいって思ってた
records.en_original: I can't say for sure. But I was thinking that I missed you when you appeared.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't say for sure. But I was thinking that I missed you when you appeared.
records.en: I don't know what really happened.<CR>But at that moment, I was wishing I could see you, Shiho-chan.

records.jp: その気持ちが、普通に暮らしてた詩帆ちゃんを<CR>ここに連れてきて、記憶も奪ったんだとしたら……
records.en_original: If I'm the one responsible for you being torn from your life and losing your memories...
records.en_auxiliary: If I'm the one responsible for you being torn from your life and losing your memories...
records.en: If those feelings brought you here from your normal life, Shiho-chan,<CR>and took your memories too...

records.jp: わたし、顔向けできない……
records.en_original: I don't know if I could take it...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know if I could take it...
records.en: I couldn't face you...

records.jp: ――わたし、「詩帆」って呼んでくれる人に<CR>出会えて、すごく安心したんです
records.en_original: I was so relieved to hear someone call my name.
records.en_auxiliary: I was so relieved to hear someone call my name.
records.en: I was so relieved to meet someone<CR>who called me 'Shiho.'

records.jp: もしかしてこの世界には、わたししかいなくて……
records.en_original: I thought that maybe I was the only one in this world.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought that maybe I was the only one in this world.
records.en: I thought that maybe I was the only one in this world.

records.jp: 誰も、わたしのことなんて<CR>覚えていないんじゃないか……
records.en_original: I thought that maybe no one would remember me...
records.en_auxiliary: I thought that maybe no one would remember me...
records.en: I was afraid no one<CR>remembered me at all...

records.jp: そうやって不安になって、心細くて……
records.en_original: I was so scared...and lonely...
records.en_auxiliary: I was so scared...and lonely...
records.en: I was so scared... and lonely...

records.jp: でも
records.en_original: But...
records.en_auxiliary: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: あなたがいてくれた。<CR>あなたがわたしのことを、覚えていてくれた――
records.en_original: You were there. And you remembered me.
records.en_auxiliary: You were there. And you remembered me.
records.en: You were here.<CR>You remembered me—

records.jp: だから……ありがとう、靭さん。<CR>わたしのことを、忘れないでいてくれて
records.en_original: So... Thank you, Kokoro. Thank you for not forgetting me.
records.en_auxiliary: So... Thank you, Kokoro. Thank you for not forgetting me.
records.en: So... thank you, Utsubo-san.<CR>Thank you for not forgetting me.

records.jp: 詩帆、ちゃん……
records.en_original: For calling me by my name...
records.en_auxiliary: For calling me by my name...
records.en: Shiho...chan...

records.jp: それで、その……お礼替わりになればと思って、<CR>こんなものを用意したんですが……
records.en_original: That's why I wanted to make this for you. To show you my gratitude.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why I wanted to make this for you. To show you my gratitude.
records.en: So, um... I prepared this,<CR>hoping it might be a token of thanks...

records.jp: コーヒー？
records.en_original: Coffee?
records.en_auxiliary: Coffee?
records.en: Coffee?

records.jp: 飲んでみて、くれませんか？
records.en_original: Would you try it?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you try it?
records.en: Would you try it?

records.jp: ……うん。もちろんなのです
records.en_original: ...Yes. Of course.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yes. Of course.
records.en: ...Yes. Of course.

records.jp: 甘いのが好きか苦いのが好きか<CR>分からなかったのですが……どちらがいいですか？
records.en_original: I wasn't sure if you like it black or with cream and sugar... Which would you prefer?
records.en_auxiliary: I wasn't sure if you like it black or with cream and sugar... Which would you prefer?
records.en: I didn't know whether you liked it sweet or bitter.<CR>Which would you prefer?

records.jp: それじゃ――
records.en_original: Well, then...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, then...
records.en: Well, then...

records.jp: 甘いので
records.en_original: Make it as sweet as you can!
records.en_auxiliary: Make it as sweet as you can!
records.en: Sweet, please.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Of course.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: はぁ、美味しかった……。<CR>詩帆ちゃん、すごいのです
records.en_original: Ahh, that was delicious... You're amazing, Shiho.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, that was delicious... You're amazing, Shiho.
records.en: Ahh, that was delicious...<CR>You're amazing, Shiho-chan.

records.jp: ふふ、ありがとうございます
records.en_original: Hehe, thank you very much.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, thank you very much.
records.en: Hehe, thank you very much.

records.jp: わたしも、なぜかはよく分からないんですが、<CR>体が勝手に動くんです
records.en_original: I don't really understand it myself, but it was like my body moved all on its own.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't really understand it myself, but it was like my body moved all on its own.
records.en: I don't really understand it myself, but<CR>my body just moves on its own.

records.jp: どうすれば美味しくできるのか、<CR>本能で理解しているというか――
records.en_original: I knew exactly what to do to make a delicious cup...
records.en_auxiliary: I knew exactly what to do to make a delicious cup...
records.en: It's as though I instinctively understand<CR>how to make it taste good—

records.jp: まるで、昔……やったことがあるみたいに
records.en_original: Like... I had done it before...
records.en_auxiliary: Like... I had done it before...
records.en: As if... I'd done it before...

records.jp: わっ！？
records.en_original: Whoa?!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa?!
records.en: Whoa?!

records.jp: この音……！　こころ！
records.en_original: This sound... Kokoro!
records.en_auxiliary: This sound... Kokoro!
records.en: This sound... Kokoro!

records.jp: うん！　きっと――
records.en_original: Yeah! It must be—
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! It must be—
records.en: Yeah! It must be—

records.jp: 春日詩帆さんのココロトープが接続されました
records.en_original: Shiho Kasuga's Heartscape is now connected.
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho Kasuga's Heartscape is now connected.
records.en: Kasuga Shiho-san's Heartscape is now connected.

records.jp: 何、この通知……
records.en_original: What is this notification...?
records.en_auxiliary: What is this notification...?
records.en: What is this notification...?

records.jp: ココロトープ……！　これって――
records.en_original: Heartscape... That's—
records.en_auxiliary: Heartscape... That's—
records.en: Heartscape... That's—

records.jp: こころの時は「秘密基地」をきっかけに<CR>ココロトープが出てきた……
records.en_original: Last time we got something like this when Kokoro talked about her secret hideout...
records.en_auxiliary: Last time we got something like this when Kokoro talked about her secret hideout...
records.en: When Kokoro's appeared, 'secret hideout' was the trigger<CR>that connected us to the Heartscape...

records.jp: きっと詩帆さんのきっかけは、<CR>「コーヒー」だったんだ！
records.en_original: Your trigger must be coffee!
records.en_auxiliary: Your trigger must be coffee!
records.en: Then 'coffee' must have been<CR>the trigger for yours, Shiho-san!

records.jp: あそこに行けば、きっと……
records.en_original: So if we go there...
records.en_auxiliary: So if we go there...
records.en: So if we go there...

records.jp: うん、見に行こう！
records.en_original: Yeah. Come on, let's check it out!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Come on, let's check it out!
records.en: Yeah. Come on, let's check it out!
